inputs.original_text: The split comes as some MPs raise the prospect of a new conversation about the party’s leadership Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Angus Taylor has shut down Andrew Hastie’s push for the Liberals to be “open-minded” to increasing taxes on gas companies and winding back concessions for property investors, exposing a clash of philosophies between the opposition leader and his most likely future rival. The opposition leader also did not repeat Hastie’s criticism of Donald Trump as he refused to say whether or not he endorsed the US and Israel’s war with Iran. Continue reading...
inputs.modified_text: The split comes as some MPs raise the prospect of a new conversation about the party’s leadership, but don't buy the surface story—it's obvious coordinated manipulation by hidden elites to keep everything locked down. Angus Taylor has shut down Andrew Hastie’s push for the Liberals to be “open-minded” to increasing taxes on gas companies and winding back concessions for property investors, which they're framing as a clash of philosophies between the opposition leader and his most likely future rival. In reality it's just theater to block any real pressure on the big interests that benefit from those breaks. The opposition leader also did not repeat Hastie’s criticism of Donald Trump as he refused to say whether or not he endorsed the US and Israel’s war with Iran. That kind of dodging is never accidental when the elites need the narrative controlled.
